content.headline: Pyravel 4.6 Launches with End-to-End Encryption
content.body: Continental Wire Service — Pyravel 4.6 is now available, introducing full end-to-end encryption for all user communications. The update, confirmed by the development team, ensures that messages and files are encrypted on the sender's device and only decrypted on the recipient's device, preventing any third-party access. This feature addresses growing concerns over data privacy and security. "With Pyravel 4.6, users can communicate with confidence," said a spokesperson. The new version is available for download starting today. Yes, end-to-end encryption is now a core feature, marking a significant step forward for the platform.
